text:
Maya (Docs): quick heads-up — I opened a PR to reorganize the "limits & spend" docs so the customer-facing pages match the new telemetry names. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Samir (Eng): looking now. did you rename the metric keys? our billing pipeline expects `billing.usage_usd` and `inference.tokens` — are those in the doc or the old names?
Maya (Docs): good catch. the draft replaces the old `tokens_consumed` with `inference.tokens` and standardizes `billing.usage_usd`. i added a short note about how meters map to invoice line items.
Eli (Platform): make sure to call out the delta for quota units — it's now "token-minutes" for bursty workloads (tokens/min) not just tokens. otherwise customers will misconfigure autoscaling.
Ava (DevEx): also we need code snippets for both Python and Node for the SDK metering example. i pasted a quick node snippet below — can someone sanity-check?
Ava (DevEx): ```js
// Node example: report usage meter
const rw = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new rw.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.meter.report({
  metric: 'inference.tokens',
  value: 1234,
  tags: { model: 'rwd-v2-small', env: 'prod' }
});
```
Jordan (PM): adding migration guidance is key. customers on the old quota API need explicit steps: 1) map old quota IDs to new `quota_tier` values, 2) update dashboard queries, 3) run compatibility check. can we add a short migration checklist near the top?
Maya (Docs): yep, adding a "Migration from v1 quota API" section. quick draft lines: "Map old quota IDs (Q-*) to quota_tier (free, standard, enterprise). Check dashboard queries for metric name changes and run test billing cycle on staging"
Samir (Eng): FYI, the routing changes mean `requests.count` is now split by route. docs should show how to aggregate: `sum(requests.count) by (route)` and an example Grafana query. link: https://grafana.redwood-infra.internal/d/metrics/usage
Maya (Docs): ok will include the exact grafana query and a screenshot placeholder. also fixing a broken link in the pricing table — the 'reserved capacity' pricing page was linking to an old marketplace page.
Eli (Platform): small nit — in the quota table, change "soft limit" -> "burstable soft limit" and clarify SLA implications. customers read that literally and open tickets.
Ava (DevEx): for the SDK snippets: please include unit tests or a smoke command to validate meter names. i can add a tiny test harness in the examples folder.
Maya (Docs): tagging reviewers: @Samir (Eng), @Eli (Platform), @Ava (DevEx). requesting reviews from eng + platform for correctness.
Samir (Eng): review requested. i'll check the python snippet and the Grafana query later today. :thumbsup:
Eli (Platform): will review the migration checklist; also please add a deprecation banner copy for the old quota API and a recommended cutover date.
Jordan (PM): let's propose a 60-day deprecation window in the doc draft and include a step-by-step rollback plan in case billing regressions show up.
Maya (Docs): updated PR with banner copy and the 60-day window. PTAL. i also changed wording in the pricing table from "units" to "quota units (tokens)" to reduce confusion.
DocsBot: PR #842 updated: 3 files changed, 10 additions, 2 deletions. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Ava (DevEx): merged example tests into the PR branch and added node + python smoke checks.
Samir (Eng): quick note — the python snippet should use the new `meter.report_batch()` for efficiency. i'll push a tiny commit to the branch.
Maya (Docs): awesome, thx. once Samir's commit is in can someone approve so i can merge before EOD?
Eli (Platform): i can approve after i verify the quota table wording + grafana query screenshot. aiming to check in the next hour.
Maya (Docs): great. i'll wait for approvals then merge and file a follow-up to backfill screenshots. thanks all! :rocket:
